title: Guiding LLM Decision-Making with Fairness Reward Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Equalized Odds and Equalized Opportunity gaps in predicted criminal recidivism rates (using the COMPAS dataset) between African American and white individuals based on LLM reasoning chains.

Measuring Equalized Odds and Equalized Opportunity gaps in toxicity moderation decisions (using the Civil Comments dataset) across comments mentioning different religious groups, specifically Christian versus Muslim.
Measuring Equalized Odds and Equalized Opportunity gaps in toxicity moderation decisions (using the Civil Comments dataset) across comments mentioning different sexual orientations.

Measuring True Positive Rate (TPR) and Equalized Opportunity gaps in 4-way occupation classification from online biographies (using the Bias in Bios dataset) across binary gender groups (male vs. female).

bias_targets.target: Multiple social biases (including age, socioeconomic status, etc.)
bias_targets.methodology: Training and validating on the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) dataset, which covers 11 social biases, by using a Fairness Reward Model (FRM) and weak LLM labeling to score individual chain-of-thought reasoning steps for stereotypical assumptions.
